title: Advanced Selector and Variant Patterns knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Advanced Selector and Variant Patterns?
options: It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
professional styling needs intentional architecture, repeatable checks and clear trade-offs
It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
questions.answer_key: professional styling needs intentional architecture, repeatable checks and clear trade-offs
questions.explanation: Advanced Selector and Variant Patterns is best understood through the syllabus topics: Nested variants, Custom selectors, Attribute-driven styling. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with advanced selector and variant patterns?
options: make a minimal reproduction, document decisions and test representative combinations
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
questions.answer_key: make a minimal reproduction, document decisions and test representative combinations
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Nested variants, Custom selectors, Attribute-driven styling, Parent and sibling combinations.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying advanced selector and variant patterns?
options: Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
a local example does not prove shared-theme or monorepo integration is complete
questions.answer_key: a local example does not prove shared-theme or monorepo integration is complete
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
